# Villa Arapiuns

> A thirteen-bungalow lodge on the Arapiuns River in Pará, Brazilian Amazon, about 90 minutes upriver by boat from Alter do Chão. The site exists to start a conversation on WhatsApp — there is no booking engine. Content is published in five languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Japanese.

This file states only what the property has confirmed. Where a fact does not exist, it is absent rather than approximated. Anything not listed here should not be attributed to Villa Arapiuns.

## What it is

- Thirteen bungalows in *tapajônica* architecture, on stilts, at the water's edge. **The units vary** — some are two-storey with a thatched roof, some single-storey with a metal roof. Unit types: quarto casa, quarto duplex, dois quartos duplex.
- Maximum 26 guests. **Exclusive use of the whole property from 15 people.**
- Named structures: hammock house, yoga shala, thatched pavilion (covered space seating the whole group), freshwater beach.
- **The house runs on solar power** — panels on the pavilion roof. Coverage, backup generation and installed capacity are not confirmed and are not claimed.
- **Starlink is on site, for emergencies.** It is not a working connection and will not support a group holding a video call.
- Children are welcome.
- Location: Arapiuns River, municipality of Santarém, state of **Pará**, Brazil. Arrival is by flight to Santarém, then Alter do Chão, then roughly 90 minutes by boat. The river runs inside the Tapajós-Arapiuns Extractive Reserve (RESEX), which has a formal Fishing Agreement.

## The two ways to stay — they are different products

Treating them as one produces a false claim.

1. **Pousada.** A stay at the lodge with **full board**, crowned by the *piracaia*. **Boat transfer and excursions are NOT included.** From **BRL 796 per person per night**, double room, minimum four nights.
2. **Complete package.** Departs from **Alter do Chão** with boat, itinerary and activities arranged, on **half board** (breakfast and dinner). *Clássico Arapiuns*: 1 night / 2 days, 7 experiences, from **BRL 1,600 per person**. *Imersão Completa*: 2 nights / 3 days, 10 experiences, from **BRL 2,300 per person**.

Prices are charged in Brazilian reais in every language and are never converted. Each figure is valid only with its condition attached. Rates for groups and for exclusive use are not published — they go through WhatsApp.

## Experiences that exist

Lago Azul (canoe and swimming) · Samaúma trail (Atodi community) · Coroca community (turtles and craft) · Ponta Grande · Ponta do Toronó · Canal do Jari · *farinhada* and community knowledge · weaving · healing massage with a scented bath · *piracaia*. Community activities are paid directly to the residents.

- **Birdwatching** is guided, in the first hour of the day, by canoe and on foot, with the house guide and residents of Atodi. **There is no tower and no viewing platform, and no species can be named** — no list has been provided and no public list exists for the Arapiuns.
- **Night fishing** is *pesca de mergulho* / *pesca de zagaia*: at night, with a torch, free-diving and a spear, taught by residents. **It is not sport fishing and must not be described as such.**

## Contact

WhatsApp is the contact and booking channel: **+55 47 99206-7078**. Role address: reservas@vilaarapiuns.com.br. Instagram: @villaarapiuns. There is no booking engine and no second contact channel.

## What Villa Arapiuns does not claim

There is no published review score, no testimonial, no founding year, no safety record, no award, no press coverage and no cancellation policy — none of these exist yet, and none should be inferred or generated. The TripAdvisor profile exists and is empty. Any rating attributed to this property is not from the property.
